Visible items: a plate with orange residue (mostly eaten, perhaps a few grams of sauce/oil), a bowl of diced tomato salad (pico de gallo, ~100 g), a small cup with a little oil or dressing (~10 g), and a glass of juice that is about 60% full (~150 g, which is not "on the plate" but is part of the meal).

If the question is about food on plates only: residue ~15 g at ~100 kcal per 100 g gives about 15 kcal, pico ~100 g at 20 kcal per 100 g gives about 20 kcal, and the dressing/oil ~10 g gives about 60 kcal if it is oil but about 40 if it is partly lemon. Total about 85 kcal for ~125 g.

Adding the juice (~150 g at ~45 kcal per 100 g, about 65 kcal) would bring it to about 150 kcal and ~275 g. I'll include the food only, plus the dressing.
